audit_status.review_note: Affliction, loneliness, mortality, Zion, creation, eternity, and later reception.

verses.restored: Hear my prayer, O YHWH, and let my cry come to thee.

familiar.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.

modern.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.

original.text: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא

verses.restored: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear to me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

familiar.text: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

modern.text: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.

original.text: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי

verses.restored: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

familiar.text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

modern.text: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.

original.text: כִּֽי כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ

verses.restored: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

familiar.text: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

modern.text: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.

original.text: הוּכָּֽה כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי

verses.restored: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

familiar.text: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

modern.text: Through my loud groaning my flesh clings to my bones.

original.text: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי

verses.restored: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

familiar.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

modern.text: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

original.text: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת

verses.restored: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

familiar.text: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

modern.text: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.

original.text: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל גָּֽג

verses.restored: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

familiar.text: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

modern.text: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.

original.text: כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ

verses.restored: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

familiar.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

modern.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears

original.text: כִּי אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי

verses.restored: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

familiar.text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

modern.text: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.

original.text: מִפְּנֵֽי זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי

verses.restored: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

familiar.text: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

modern.text: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.

original.text: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ

verses.restored: But you, YHWH, remain forever, and your remembrance from generation to generation.

familiar.text: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

modern.text: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר

verses.restored: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

familiar.text: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

modern.text: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor— the appointed time has come.

original.text: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

familiar.text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

modern.text: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.

original.text: כִּֽי רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ

verses.restored: So the nations shall fear the name of YHWH, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

familiar.text: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

modern.text: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.

original.text: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: When YHWH shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

familiar.text: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

modern.text: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.

original.text: כִּֽי בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ

verses.restored: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

familiar.text: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

modern.text: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.

original.text: פָּ֭נָה אֶל תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת תְּפִלָּתָֽם

verses.restored: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise YHWH.

familiar.text: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

modern.text: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.

original.text: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל יָֽהּ

verses.restored: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did YHWH behold the earth;

familiar.text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

modern.text: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth

original.text: כִּֽי הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם אֶל אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט

verses.restored: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

familiar.text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

modern.text: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,

original.text: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה

verses.restored: To declare the name of YHWH in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

familiar.text: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

modern.text: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,

original.text: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve YHWH.

familiar.text: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

modern.text: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.

original.text: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

familiar.text: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

modern.text: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.

original.text: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ כחו קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי

verses.restored: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

familiar.text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

modern.text: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.

original.text: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

familiar.text: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

notes.title: Creation language and Hebrews
notes.body: Hebrews 1 later applies Psalm 102:25–27 christologically. The Hebrew psalm itself addresses God within an afflicted person’s prayer; both literary settings should remain visible.

modern.text: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.

original.text: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם

verses.restored: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

familiar.text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

modern.text: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.

original.text: הֵ֤מָּה יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ

verses.restored: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

familiar.text: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

modern.text: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.

original.text: וְאַתָּה ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ

verses.restored: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

familiar.text: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

modern.text: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”

original.text: בְּנֵֽי עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Suffering and physical decline are not moral failure; Zion restoration language cannot erase modern peoples or contested history.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
